title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：scarf　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 scarf 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the tailor ① wore the scarf that no customer in the shop would have measured, and he said the wearing was the whole of the week. The ② scarf, meaning the wrap itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a scarf, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ scarf in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ scarf at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A scarf, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the tailor said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the scarf was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the wrap. The ⑥ scarf, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; scarf, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a wrap and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ scarf had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ scarf of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of measuring; scarf, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ scarf I remember is the wrap measured in the order, which closed in 1960 and is still measured as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ scarf, my mother said in 1962, is the only wrap that improves by being measured; every scarf, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a wrap. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 围巾（指裁缝铺里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 围巾（指那条围巾本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the scarf 围这一条围巾
D. n. 围巾（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 围巾之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的围巾之事）
F. n. 围巾（指订单簿里写到、被测量的那一条）
G. n. 围巾、暖意（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the scarf that no customer in the shop would have measured
The scarf, meaning the wrap itself and not the needle
the scarf at the far mirror
the scarf was the whole of the matter

The scarf of the whole thing

answers.why: wear the scarf 意为“围这一条围巾”，1953 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯测量的一条围巾做了一遍。
scarf 意为“围巾”，指那条围巾本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
scarf 意为“围巾”，指裁缝铺里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
scarf 意为“围巾”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
scarf 意为“围巾、暖意”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条暖意就是那件事的全部。
scarf 意为“暖意”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条围巾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
scarf 意为“围巾”，指订单簿里写到、被测量的那一条，到 1958 年这一条成了订单簿里的一行。
scarf 意为“围巾之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的围巾之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的测量。
scarf 意为“围巾”，我记得的是订单簿里测量过的那一条，1960 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一条。
scarf 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，围巾是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的围巾。
